messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for model=redwood-open-encoder-v2; canary_traffic=20%; rollout_id=rollout-231
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert - /v1/generate p95 > 800ms (5m window). Paging eng-oncall.
maya: I'm oncall, ack. linking dashboards
jason: joining — which canary?
maya: redwood-open-encoder-v2 canary at 20% (started ~2m ago). metrics: p95 ~1.2s, p99 ~2.6s. streaming stalls reported.
liam: seeing tail spikes on hosts gpu-14,gpu-22. KV cache miss rate jumped ~3x around rollout time.
sara: logs show intermittent "kv_cache_miss" and a flurry of resends from streaming connection manager. snippet: ```[2024-07-02T12:00:15Z] req_id=abc123 stage=stream write_delay_ms=1200 kv_cache_miss=true```
nate: any config diffs? batch sizes, aten kernels, quant profile?
maya: model variant was "v2-opt-clean" (smaller tokens but different op-fusion). No config changes to runtime.
jason: can we confirm input length distribution changed? maybe canary sent more long prompts.
liam: checked traces — prompt lengths similar. The perf delta looks like more KV cache churn per request, not length.
cs-rep-olivia: FYI CS: one customer reported degraded streaming UX (stuttering) to support. They asked if it's a canary rollout.
maya: thanks. prioritizing mitigation: options = 1) scale down canary traffic, 2) rollback to previous model, 3) tweak runtime batching/cache. Immediate action: reduce traffic to 5% and evaluate.
nate: agree. I'll prepare rollback if traffic reduction doesn't help in 3–5min.
deploy-bot: Executing traffic shift via router API: canary_traffic 20 -> 5% (actioned by maya).
maya: done — traffic set to 5%. monitor dashboards.
jason: p95 dropped to ~950ms but still noisy. p99 still ~2.0s. a lot of streaming stalls persist.
sara: samples of stalled streams show repeated re-requests from client side after stall. possible ephemeral GC on runtime or kernel path regression.
liam: I can repro locally by running v2-opt-clean with same concurrency; observe occasional 1.5–2s stalls on sequence generation step. attaching local trace snippet: ```call_stack: attention_kernel -> runtime_dispatch -> memcpy_sync```
nate: given persistent stalls, recommend rollback to v1 (previous stable) for now. I'll coordinate.
maya: rolling back canary -> v1-stable; initiating rollback; this will set canary traffic to 0 and revert canary hosts.
deploy-bot: Rollback started: target_model=v1-stable; rollout_id=rollout-231; action=rollback; initiated_by=maya
jason: ETA on rollback completion?
deploy-bot: Canaries draining; expected ~90s to converge.
liam: monitoring host-level metrics — KV cache miss rate is trending down as v2 drains.
sara: streaming stalls count down to normal baseline. p95 now ~420ms, p99 ~810ms and trending down.
cs-rep-olivia: Notifying impacted customer: "We've reverted a canary rollout which caused streaming stutters; service restored. Root cause under investigation."
maya: rollback complete and validated. p95 ~380ms, p99 ~620ms; no further page.
jason: creating incident ticket INC-2024-231 with timeline and artifacts. Assigning follow-ups: - perf regression repro + kernel diff (liam) - KV cache instrumentation improvement (sara) - stricter canary throttles for large ops (product)
nate: I'll keep a hotfix branch ready for kernel/dispatch revert if we find a specific op causing stall.
liam: initial hypothesis: op-fusion variant in v2-opt-clean triggers an unfavorable memcpy_sync path under certain concurrent streaming patterns. Need deeper profiling.
maya: handing off oncall to jason for the next 8h. I'm free if needed.
jason: ack handoff. I'll watch dashboards and coordinate postmortem.
cs-rep-olivia: CS will follow up with the customer with a timeline and offer a postmortem once available.
maya: closing thread for now. action items in INC-2024-231. Good work everyone :thumbsup:
